t: A ready-built robot buggy that a BBC micro:bit drives and controls.
steps: Buy the :MOVE Motor from DigiKey or RobotShop in the US for about 39 to 40 US dollars, or from Kitronik in the UK.
Get a BBC micro:bit, a USB cable, and four AA batteries.
Fit the wheels and slide the micro:bit into the buggy.
Open the MakeCode editor in your web browser and add the move motor extension.
Try the first tutorial and drag blocks to drive forward and stop.
Download the program to the micro:bit and switch the buggy on.
Try the line following and ultrasonic tutorials next.
Use the motor balance blocks to help it drive straight.
meta: Open Code. From $38.64. A few stores.
